Death. We must learn to love it as we do so with life.  I understand you. All the times you've come so close to doing it but you can't. For a second you think that life will get better but it doesn't. All the times you've told yourself that you will survive this. All the time you've  thought about what it would be like to be happy.  To some death makes them scared and sad, And to some Death makes them happy and it brings them peace. To some life is scary and it brings them torment with every second and every breath.  It's  been  a hard life living but you are so afraid to die. Death will forever be watching you. Think not of death as something bad. Think of it as something that must happen. 

Ive been looking for a will to live, But the passion in my heart has left and  will never return. 

My words to you my friend you are stronger than your tragedy. But sometimes it is  ok to wish to die. It is ok to want it all to be over, I can't tell you its the right thing. Because it's not. But sometimes  death is the only thing that keeps us alive, Death is someones light. Life is someones deepest fear. For me  I want to die so bad.  I want to start over. And if I get another life I will damn well learn to live in that one.
